AC AMENDMENT (plan-review F1, F2 + gap-analysis F5):
- [ ] append_cycle accepts pr_number: int = _SENTINEL_PR_NUMBER and embeds it in the cycle entry
  Verify: grep -qE 'def append_cycle.*pr_number' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py
- [ ] reconstruct_from_pr_comments uses _MARKER_RE_V12 branch first, falls back to _MARKER_RE_V11 (returning sentinel=0)
  Verify: python3 -c 'import re; src = open("plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py").read(); assert "_MARKER_RE_V12" in src and "reconstruct_from_pr_comments" in src'
- [ ] reconstruct_from_pr_comments skips malformed/partial markers with a warning log, does NOT raise (continues processing remaining markers)
  Verify: grep -qE 'warning|WARNING|skip.*marker' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/cycle_ledger.py
- [ ] T1's round-trip test exercises append_cycle write path and recovers pr_number via subsequent read
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-cycle-ledger-migration.sh
